name: CYCLE_PLAN_STATUS
description: This table contains data for what cycle plans have been finalized and by whom.

columns.name: CYCLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the cycle record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PLAN_CARD_C_NAME
columns.description: The cycle plan card. This item is the key for each line.

columns.name: PLAN_STATE_C_NAME
columns.description: The state of the plan, whether it has been finalized or amended

columns.name: PLAN_UPDATE_USER_ID
columns.description: The user that signed or amended the plan

columns.name: PLAN_UPDATE_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: PLAN_UPDATE_INSTANT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant a plan was signed/amended

columns.name: AMENDMENT_REASON_C_NAME
columns.description: The reason the user is amending the plan

columns.name: AMENDMENT_REASON_COMMENT
columns.description: The free-text reason for amending the plan
